title: Policy-specific minimum collateral

authority.compatibility_note: ComputeWorkerStake420 retains its older local worker-admission policy surface until CMP-1.5.9 integration; it is not the canonical CMP-1.5 minimum-collateral policy authority.

requirements: each revision independently defines whether worker and verifier collateral are required
required worker and verifier roles have nonzero active/slashable minima with slashable <= active
disabled roles must carry zero collateral minima
worker and verifier minimums are independently evaluated
policy revisions preserve immutable historical terms and commitments
new-acceptance gating is separate from immutable revision terms
current-acceptance verification requires exact current revision and commitment
worker position evaluation enforces active/slashable thresholds, active state and optional exit rejection
verifier position evaluation enforces authority/revision presence, active/slashable thresholds, active state and optional exit rejection
the policy contract never custodies collateral and never selects stake sources

milestone.rationale: CMP-1.5.1 worker collateral, CMP-1.5.2 verifier collateral, and CMP-1.5.3 shared minimum policy now converge into the first complete collateral-admission model.
milestone.cross_role_integration: ComputeStakeCollateralPolicy420 tests exercise both worker and verifier position schemas against one policy revision.

deferred: CMP-1.5.9 WorkerRegistry stake-source and canonical-policy integration
